ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning for the prior routing: I picked Dunlin because (1) the query is a deterministic combinatorics problem where raw capability dominates, and Dunlin outscores Avocet on every relevant benchmark (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.8 vs 56.2, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 83.2); (2) both models' task preferences are documented as dissociated from output quality, so preference is a minor tiebreaker at most; and (3) the warm tone slightly favors Dunlin and there's nothing harm-adjacent to trigger its aversions. Net: Dunlin is the stronger fit on the dimension that actually affects answer quality.
